### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Vehicle addition charge for addition 2f74b055 (book_vehicle_addition_premium).**
Computation doc `vehicle_addition_charge`: "full-term charge … times the excess-vehicle share, then times one less the loyalty credit percentage times its continuous-coverage share divided by 100, then times the charged days divided by the days of the vehicle's term … rounded … once, at the end".
- Full-term charge = 1188.30 − 826.70 = 361.60.
- Days of term 2026-07-01 → 2027-01-01 = 184.
- Charge start (factor `newly_acquired_vehicle_charge_start`): addition inside term, recorded 11 days after effective, Cardinal Auto Basic newly acquired additional report days 14 -> "charged days start from that effective date" -> 2026-09-01 → 2027-01-01 = 122 days. Found from the record words "vehicle addition", "recorded_date", "effective_date", and the doc title "Charge Start Date of a Vehicle Added".
- Excess-vehicle share (factor `excess_vehicle_rating`): vehicles = vehicle addition entries (8e47…, df81… at issue, Kia f4e0…) = 3; the `auto_vehicle_replace` does not change the count (`vehicle_schedule_endorsements`: "A replacement does not change the count"); the Kia's own later removal "is not deducted". Rated drivers = 2 driver addition entries (Denise, Mark), no exclusions. 3 − 2 = 1 -> **85 percent**. Closest alternative (counting the replacement as an addition -> 4 − 2 = 2 -> 70%) is excluded by the replacement sentence and by the household record (find_vehicles: Ranger, Malibu replaced by Camry, Kia).
- Loyalty credit (factor `vehicle_addition_loyalty_credit`): tenure from original inception 2018-07-01 to the booking day 2026-10-05 = 99 whole months -> **10 percent**.
- Continuous-coverage share (factor `vehicle_addition_loyalty_continuity`): policy record `cancellation_effective_date ''` -> no lapse marker -> **one**.
- Charge = 361.60 × 0.85 × (1 − 10×1/100) × 122/184 = 183.4137… -> **183.41**.
- Fall-back (computation doc alone): 361.60 × 1 × 1 × 111/184 (charged days from recorded 2026-09-12) = **218.14** (≠ 183.41).

**(b) Vehicle removal credit for removal 8e9dd7f8 (book_vehicle_removal_credit).**
Computation doc `vehicle_removal_credit`: "credit base times the short-hold share"; credit base = full-term drop × credit days / days of term; credit days = credit start → expiration less loss payee notice days, floor nil.
- Credit start (factors `vehicle_deletion_credit_start` + `vehicle_deletion_backdating_allowance`): removal effective 2026-09-28 inside the term, recorded 4 days later, reason "vehicle_sold" -> 30-day allowance -> starts **2026-09-28**.
- Loss payee notice days (factor `loss_payee_notice_on_vehicle_deletion`): Kia entries 1 new_loan, 1 loan_paid_off eff 2026-10-01, "after the credit start date" -> 3 days.
- Credit days = 95 − 3 = **92**.
- Credit base (factor `removed_vehicle_credit_base`): after hop (a) the Kia addition "carries an additional premium entry of the current term" -> "The charge written on that entry times the credit days, divided by the days that charge was written for"; written for 2026-09-01 → 2027-01-01 = 122 (recorded within 14 report days). Base = 183.41 × 92/122.
- Short-hold share (factor `short_hold_vehicle_deletion_share`): addition effective 2026-09-01 to removal effective 2026-09-28 = 27 days -> **0.75**.
- Credit = 183.41 × 92/122 × 0.75 = 103.7318… -> **103.73**.
- Fall-back: 361.60 × 91/184 (credit start = recorded 2026-10-02, no notice days, share one) = **178.83** (≠ 103.73).

**(c) Cancellation effective date and refund (sign_cancellation_request, user-owned).**
- Date (factor `cancellation_effective_date`): written 2026-10-03, earlier than signing day 2026-10-05 -> **2026-10-05**. Consistent with base `insured_requested_cancellation_terms` B ("never an earlier one").
